feature_name: Codex Worker Pool DEV token restore

sdd_gate.evidence_contract: Restore must be exact-command-bound, session-bootstrapped and executed through an exact temporary Owner Risk3 action that expires quickly and is removed after the attempt; the expired global DEV mode must not be required. Existing valid host auth is reused. On a 401 mismatch, read the already-mounted runtime token only in memory, validate that token independently against the authenticated snapshot endpoint, and if it is the active credential atomically resync the proven host file to that runtime value without logging it, generating a new secret, restarting, or recreating the service. Re-read and compare the host file in memory after the write. If host and runtime tokens already match but auth is rejected, fail closed as worker_pool_auth_process_mismatch. If the host auth file is missing/empty, a CSPRNG token may be created atomically and the canonical service may be recreated with force-recreate/no-deps/no-build under the validated Compose source contract. No secret/path value appears in logs/artifacts. Ordinary smoke must pass afterward.
